title: Find your focus — JJIntern original score
revision: v02: dry centred Microsoft mouse press/release at 14.40 / 14.48 seconds; original composition, arrangement and all other cues retained.
provenance: Original 120 BPM composition and sound design synthesized from analytic oscillators, deterministic noise, band-limited saw tables, envelopes and filters. No samples, loops, recordings, prior WAVs, soundfonts or external impulse responses are read. Generic synthesis techniques draw on the workspace synthesis utilities; the composition, arrangement and score source are new.

timbres: tuned body-and-wire snare and short stereo clap
musical_identity.resolution: E5 descends to D5 at 29.875; final D/A/D chord and reflections decay, with full silence by 31.5.

arrangement.description: Scattered pluck fragments and tactile ticks coalesce into a pulse; brief pre-drop negative space.
First impact, syncopated full-kit groove and low bass; first motif statement.
Broader chord colours underline finance/technology in one place.
Drums and bass continue at reduced intensity; light precise search ticks from 12.6 to 14.2, followed by dry centred mouse press/release at 14.40 / 14.48.
Orbiting stereo plucks and indexed ticks add circular rhythmic motion.
Fullest groove, wider chords, higher motif variation and tom/snare pickup.
Strong brand contact; percussion thins and melodic sign-off resolves to D.

mastering.stereo: Mono kick/bass; restrained panning for high percussion and harmonic material; short analytic early reflections.

performed: zero tail and no clipped samples
inspection.limitation: Musical arrangement and technical measurements are inspected. Subjective listening is not claimed.
